$comment: Declarative model catalogue. Adding a model means adding an entry here -
no change to init.sh or the Dockerfile. Select what a pod downloads with
the MODEL_SETS environment variable (comma-separated set names).
'size_gb' is informational and used for the pre-flight disk-space check.

minimax-h3-fl2va.description: MiniMax H3 - Text-to-Video and Image-to-Video (first/last frame). 2K, 24fps, native stereo audio.

minimax-h3-ref2va.description: MiniMax H3 - Reference-to-Video. Character consistency, style and motion transfer. Shares the text encoder and VAEs with fl2va.

minimax-h3-turbo-lora.description: Step-distillation LoRA for fl2va. Runs at 6 steps instead of 12 and needs the MiniMax-H3 Turbo Sampler node, so it changes nothing until a workflow loads it. v4-600 EMA is upstream's recommended checkpoint at 6-8 steps; the v1 line it replaces over-sharpens at strength 1.0, which showed up here as grain the moment the node started applying the LoRA at run time instead of merging it into int8 weights. ckpt500 stays for rollback. 1.6 GB, hence on by default.

minimax-h3-ref2v-turbo-lora.description: Step-distillation LoRA for ref2va, the only one that exists for that task - the larryvrh set covers fl2va alone. Load it with the STOCK LoraLoaderModelOnly node, never with MiniMaxH3TurboLoRA: the two turbo lineages target different checkpoints, larryvrh the pruned one and lightx2v the full bf16, and larryvrh's node performs an adaln-curve injection specific to the pruned structure. Feeding it this file put the deltas on a path they were never computed for and the output came out in filaments. This is Kijai's rank-20 repack of lightx2v's LoRA - the author's name inside the filename is the author of the original, not of the repack. Measured against the 1.96 GB full-rank original twice: +1.3% against a 1.6% spread, indistinguishable on the clock, indistinguishable by eye on a fixed seed, and 0.6 GB lighter in steady-state VRAM across every run. Six times smaller for nothing given up, so the original is not shipped; fetch it from lightx2v/Minimax-h3-Turbo if a comparison is ever needed again. Upstream distils and recommends 4 steps, but that assumes their bf16 base: on a pruned int8 checkpoint the delta lands on rounded weights, the distilled trajectory is only approximated, and 4 steps have no room to recover it. Six is the working value here and the two extra steps are the price of the quantisation. Shift 12 video and 3 audio. Trained at 544p, and it holds well from 0.4 to 0.6 MP.

minimax-h3-fp8.description: MiniMax H3 fl2va in fp8_scaled instead of int8_convrot. Alternative quantisation - try it if int8 convrot misbehaves on your driver.

minimax-h3-hq.description: MiniMax H3 fl2va in unpruned int8_convrot (34 GB) with the int8 text encoder. Exceeds a single 32 GB card comfortably - for multi-GPU or heavy-RAM hosts only.

minimax-h3-vae-int8.description: Video VAE quantised to int8_convrot, 2.95 GB instead of 5.21. Measured here: 14.63 s -> 12.96 s on a 3 s clip at 0.6 MP, -11.4% against a 2.5% spread, with no visible difference on a fixed-seed A/B decoding one sampler output through both. That implies decode is about 5 s, a third of the run, and confirms the 1.5x upstream claims. Needs ComfyUI 0.31.0 or newer - older cores decode to black frames. fp16 still ships with the fl2va set, so reverting is a widget, not a download.

minimax-h3-w4a8.description: fl2va and ref2va in the experimental w4a8 format - 4-bit weights, int8-convrot activations. 11.68 and 10.96 GB against 20.97 each. With the int8 VAE the whole set falls to about 31 GB, which is the first time it would fit a 32 GB card without permanent offload. Needs comfy-kitchen 0.2.27+, which ComfyUI pins from 0.31.0 onward. Its author calls it experimental and at testing phase, so judge the output before trusting the size.
